name: db-elevate
description: DB Elevate - employee performance management platform

scripts.setup: node scripts/setup-env.mjs && npm install && prisma migrate deploy && prisma generate && npm run db:seed
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:browser
scripts.test:browser: node tests/browser/catalog-test.js && node tests/browser/admin-test.js && node tests/browser/calibration-test.js && node tests/browser/development-test.js && node tests/browser/infra-test.js && node tests/browser/competencies-test.js && node tests/browser/search-case-test.js && SEED_FORCE=1 tsx prisma/seed.ts && node tests/browser/compensation-test.js && node tests/browser/compensation-flow-test.js && SEED_FORCE=1 tsx prisma/seed.ts && node tests/browser/compensation-budget-test.js && SEED_FORCE=1 tsx prisma/seed.ts
scripts.setup:blank: node scripts/setup-env.mjs && npm install && prisma migrate deploy && prisma generate
scripts.test:compensation: SEED_FORCE=1 tsx prisma/seed.ts && node tests/browser/compensation-test.js && node tests/browser/compensation-flow-test.js && SEED_FORCE=1 tsx prisma/seed.ts && node tests/browser/compensation-budget-test.js && SEED_FORCE=1 tsx prisma/seed.ts
scripts.vercel-build: prisma generate && prisma migrate deploy && next build
